validators.remediation: Review whether the header is necessary and reduce unnecessary product or version disclosure where operationally feasible.

testCases.title: Other customer cannot view owner order details
testCases.impact: A non-owner could view an order object if the test actor receives a successful response for the owner object's URL.
testCases.remediation: Verify object ownership server-side for every order detail request.
notes: Example only. Replace path, actors, and object ID with owner-approved test data before use.

testCases.title: Payment state transition requires owner-approved evidence
testCases.expectedOutcome: Payment state cannot be changed without the authorized payment processor callback or owner-approved test harness.
testCases.impact: A payment workflow bypass could alter order fulfillment, price, refund, or settlement state.
testCases.remediation: Bind payment state changes to signed processor events, idempotency keys, amount/currency checks, and server-side order ownership validation.
notes: Keep payment/refund checks evidence-only unless a separate reviewed non-production payment runner is approved.
